name: Peach oil
description: Peach oil (CAS 8023-98-1 ), also known as Persic oil, is a fixed oil cold-pressed from the kernels of Prunus persica. It functions as an emollient carrier and mild flavoring agent across food, fragrance, and personal care manufacturing. In cosmetic formulations, it serves as a lightweight carrier oil in facial serums, massage oils, and skin creams. Smooth skin absorption and compatibility with active ingredients are priorities for formulators in these applications. Fragrance and flavor houses incorporate it as a carrier or blending medium in peach-type flavor profiles. It is commonly used for confectionery, beverages, and baked goods to enhance the sensory profile of the final product. Personal care manufacturers use it in hair conditioning products and lip care formulations where its skin-feel properties support finished product texture. It also appears in premium soap and bath oil formulations. The oil is a natural, fruit-derived ingredient that meets specific label and positioning requirements for high-end brands. Peach oil is supplied as a pale yellow liquid, typically in drum and IBC quantities for industrial buyers. Smaller pack sizes are available for specialty formulators requiring precise amounts. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the standard commercial offerings for global distribution and manufacturing needs. Food-grade material conforms to applicable purity and quality benchmarks for edible oils.
